description: Time Series Data of Load, Generation, and Power Flow in IEEE Bus Systems is a data set deposited in IEEE DataPort by its authors Md Hasan Shahriar. "This dataset provides time series measurements of load, generation, and transmission line power flows for standard IEEE test bus systems, including the 14-bus, 30-bus, and 118-bus networks. Data are available at two temporal resolutions\u2014hourly and 30-second intervals\u2014capturing both long-term operational patterns and short-term system dynamics. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and IEEE DataPort normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-ieeedp-repository.
